Overview

Gualeguaychú is a city in Entre Ríos with a population of 109,461. Entre Ríos’ carnival capital with the famous Masquerade Carnival, thermal parks, and the Uruguay River. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
